mapper.select:
select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, con.con_Money_Tentative as conMoneyTentative, con.con_Provisional_Pe as conProvisionalPe, c1.C_Name as vfContractorName, c2.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as vfContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, vr.Vr_Code as vrCode, vr.Vr_Time as vrTime, vr.Vr_Participant as vrParticipant, vr.Vr_Place as vrPlace, vr.Vr_Content as vrContent, cl.Cl_Title as clTitle, cl2.Cl_Title as vfClTitle, cl2.Cl_Id as clId, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Project_Director as pProjectDirector, pro.P_Project_Director_Tel as pProjectDirectorTel, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, svis.Svis_Name as svisName, svis.Svis_Code as svisCode, svis.Svis_Project_Name as svisProjectName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, (select csb.Csb_Estimate_Amt from Con_Sv_Budget csb where csb.Svis_Id=mn.Svis_Id and csb.State=7 limit 1) as csbEstimateAmt, mn.* from Con_Visa_Fee mn left join Con_Visa_Record vr on vr.Vr_Id=mn.Vr_Id left join Con_Contact_List cl on cl.Cl_Id = vr.Vr_Cl_Id left join Con_Contact_List cl2 on cl2.Cl_Id = mn.Cl_Id
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=vr.Con_Id
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Vf_Contractor left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Vf_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c2 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c2.C_Id left join Con_Svis svis on svis.Svis_Id=mn.Svis_Id where mn.Vf_Id=#{vfId}

select
pro.P_Project_Director as pProjectDirector, pro.P_Project_Director_Tel as pProjectDirectorTel,
con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, c2.C_Name as conPartyBName, c2.C_Name_History as conPartyBNameHistory, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName,
vr.Vr_Code as vrCode, c1.C_Name as vfContractorName, c1.C_Name_History as vfContractorNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as vfContractorAbbName, svis.Svis_Name as svisName, svis.Svis_Code as svisCode, svis.Svis_Project_Name as svisProjectName, svis.Svis_Sub_Code as svisSubCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, (select csb.Csb_Estimate_Amt from Con_Sv_Budget csb where csb.Svis_Id=mn.Svis_Id and csb.State=7 limit 1) as csbEstimateAmt, mn.* from Con_Visa_Fee mn left join Con_Visa_Record vr on vr.Vr_Id=mn.Vr_Id
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=vr.Con_Id
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join SYS_Company c2 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c2.C_Id
left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Vf_Contractor left join Con_Svis svis on svis.Svis_Id=mn.Svis_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Vf_Id
${params.authSql}
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Vf_Create_Time desc
